column2: Wide panoramic background painting for the city view of a turn-based strategy game, bold clean outlines, soft cel shading, vivid natural colours, warm daylight, seen from slightly above. A broad flat empty meadow of short green grass fills the lower two thirds of the picture and is open and even everywhere, with gentle hills and distant forests on the horizon and a blue sky with a few soft white clouds in the upper third. No buildings, no roads, no fences, no trees in the foreground, no people, no animals, no text.
